tasks.partName: Đọc to đoạn văn (Read a Text Aloud)
tasks.prompt: Read the text aloud. You will be evaluated on pronunciation, intonation, and rhythm.
tasks.textToRead: The Eagleton Hotel is proud to announce the completion of its new Convention 2 Center. With advanced audio-visual equipment, dining facilities, and plenty of space, it’s the perfect location for any corporate event. To reserve the Eagleton Hotel Convention Center, simply call one of our friendly customer service agents at 1-800-555-0035. You can also arrange a tour of the facilities with the center manager, Lisa Cambell. Call today!

Welcome to the Alto Motors factory tour. My name is Jimmy Saunders, and I’ll be showing you around the facility today. On the tour, you'll learn all about how our award-winning automobiles are manufactured. We'll begin here in the design department, where skilled technicians come up with all the design specifications for our vehicles. I'll lead you through the department, and then we'll actually have the opportunity to speak with one of the technicians that works here.

tasks.partName: Miêu tả bức tranh (Describe a Picture)
tasks.prompt: Describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as possible.

photos.imageDescription: Miêu tả bức tranh chi tiết về bối cảnh, con người, hành động và các chi tiết phụ.
photos.sampleBand8Answer: In this photograph, we observe an active and well-illuminated setting. In the foreground, people are focused on their individual tasks while interacting productively. In the middle ground, essential tools and work materials are neatly arranged across the table. In the background, the architectural background and natural lighting establish a modern and organized atmosphere. Overall, the entire scene conveys a strong sense of teamwork and efficiency.

questions.question: How often do you use your Internet service and when do you usually use it?
questions.modelAnswer: I use my Internet service constantly every day, primarily during daytime work hours and in the evening for streaming movies.

questions.question: How much do you pay per month for your Internet service, and do you think the cost is reasonable?
questions.modelAnswer: I pay around thirty dollars per month, and I think the cost is quite reasonable given the high speed and reliable connection.

questions.question: How do you think your Internet service could be improved?
questions.modelAnswer: The service could be improved by providing faster customer support resolution and upgrading fiber-optic bandwidth during peak evening hours.

tasks.partName: Trả lời theo thông tin cho sẵn (Respond using Information Provided)
tasks.scenario: Bạn sẽ nhận được một lịch trình/thông tin công việc và trả lời 3 câu hỏi liên quan.
tasks.scheduleText:
Respond to questions using the information provided

But before I do, I'd like to ask you a few questions about the tour schedule.

tasks.scheduleHtml:
Respond to questions using the information provided

Hello. I’m interested in reserving tickets for a tour of the Wright River this Saturday. But before I do, I'd like to ask you a few questions about the tour schedule.

Question 8: How much will it cost to buy tickets for my four children and me?

Question 9: Last year, passengers had to bring their own lunch. Is that also true this year?

Question 10: I’m curious about the schedule of events that will take place after lunch. What will happen as we go back downstream?

questions.modelAnswer: According to the provided schedule, the event is scheduled to start promptly at 9:00 A.M. in the main auditorium.
Actually, that information is not correct. The session has been rescheduled to the morning, and all participants are invited to attend.
Certainly. There are two sessions scheduled in the afternoon: first, a workshop from 1:30 to 2:45 P.M., followed by a closing discussion at 3:00 P.M.

tasks.partName: Trình bày quan điểm (Express an Opinion)
tasks.prompt: There is a plan to offer free wireless service in your city, but there will be a slight tax increase as a result. Would you be in favor of the planned tax increase? Give reasons and details to support.
tasks.sampleBand8Answer: I firmly support this stance for two key reasons. First, this approach grants individuals significant flexibility and helps reduce daily cognitive fatigue. Second, having such balanced conditions promotes sustained motivation and superior long-term performance. Therefore, I believe this is unquestionably the most effective choice.
